answer: A new seat is not minted from a name alone. The applicant locks a ferrous bond equal to three times the epoch's median wage, hashed to one hardware serial that the contract will not rebind. The registry cuts a single jade tablet committing to that serial. Three already-seated relays, acting as raven couriers on disjoint autonomous-system paths, must each finish a signed challenge-response with the serial before cutoff. If two keys share a serial, a funding UTXO, or more than one raven hop, both ferrous deposits are slashed and the cluster collapses to one seat.
